claims.population: The last known population of Abakaliki was 223,000 (year 2022); the metro area was estimated at 662,000 (year 2023).
claims.economy: Abakaliki is a centre of agricultural trade including yams, cassava, rice, palm oil and palm kernels, and is known for local lead, zinc, salt and limestone mining or quarrying.
claims.religion: The people are predominantly Christian; on 1 March 1973 the city became the seat of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Abakaliki.
